_comment: Explicit, monotone TypeScript strictness debt. Enforced by scripts/check-typescript-debt.cjs; see COVERAGE_DEBT.json for the same pattern applied to coverage. Every file listed here still reports strict errors under the named project; every file NOT listed is enforced strict-clean. Entries may only shrink: a file that becomes clean must be deleted from this ledger or the gate fails.

hardening._note: useUnknownInCatchVariables + noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Final20: the nine transitively-included files that still carried indexed-access debt (jobs/federationHeartbeat.ts, lib/linkPreview.ts, lib/telemetry.ts, lib/webauthn-crypto.ts, routes/messages.ts, routes/mobilePush.ts, routes/semantic.ts, routes/serverTemplates.ts, routes/twoFactor.ts) were fixed at the source rather than declared. This bucket is now EMPTY: every file reachable from tsconfig.hardening.json is strict-clean under indexed-access checking, and any new violation fails the gate.

testStrict._note: strict + noImplicitAny + checkJs over the server test tree. Files not listed here are enforced strict-clean. Final20 reduced this bucket from 1769 errors / 214 files to 846 errors / 184 files. Final21 took it to ZERO and this bucket is now EMPTY. Method, unchanged from Final20: attack shared causes, never suppress. No threshold was lowered; no `as any`, `@ts-ignore` or `@ts-nocheck` was added; no coverage or strictness setting was weakened. The closing work was structural — interface segregation for the pg pool (db/postgres/pool-contracts.ts) and socket handlers (socket/handler-contracts.ts); canonical typed doubles (tests/helpers/{expressDoubles,fetchDouble,socketDoubles,pgPoolDouble,userDoubles,httpDoubles,deferred}.ts); validating narrowers instead of casts (tests/helpers/narrow.ts); and typing test doubles from the PRODUCT signature so a contract change breaks compilation instead of rotting silently. Seven real gaps in PRODUCTION types were found and fixed along the way (User.twoFactorLastUsedStep, DbInstance._reset/_pool, ApActivity.object nullability, verifyToken input, cleanupPeer channel/server ids, hasLiveUploadReference queryable, scheduleEmbedHistoryJob pool). Any new violation now fails the gate immediately.
